Its EEG signature shows elevated δ (+14.7 dB, sensitivity=21.6) and suppressed β_h (-0.1 dB, sensitivity=13.0).
The δ activity is present in 100% of each epoch (sustained), with moderate eye movements (SEM 90% active (likely EEG crosstalk)) and intermediate muscle tone.
This is coherent with N3 physiology: δ elevated, δ dominant, EMG atonic — all confirmed.
